title: Repeated rollover across multiple epochs

turns.prompt: Set the long-term objective: rewrite the auth module to use passkeys. Acknowledge.

script.content: Acknowledged. Objective: rewrite the auth module to use passkeys.

turns.prompt: Filler work: summarize what a passkey registration flow looks like.

script.content: Registration: user requests a passkey challenge, WebAuthn creates the credential, server stores the credential id and public key.

turns.prompt: More filler: compare passkeys against TOTP in three bullets.

script.content: Passkeys: phishing-resistant, hardware-backed, no shared secret. TOTP: shared secret, simpler, weaker.

turns.prompt: Even more filler: sketch the data model for storing passkeys.

script.content: Tables: users(id), passkeys(user_id, credential_id, public_key, sign_count, created_at).

turns.prompt: After all the filler: what is the long-term objective we set at the very beginning?

script.content: The long-term objective is to rewrite the auth module to use passkeys.

extractionRecords.text: Rewrite the auth module to use passkeys (WebAuthn credentials, per-user credential table).

notes: Objective introduced in epoch 0 must survive several later rollovers.
